Measured RW float formatter transport from full own bodies, all five holdings.
The corresponding actual formatter call places the buffer at a0, full double
at a2/a3, and conversion/width/precision at caller stack16/20/24.
The helper prologue stores a2 at+0x148 and a3 at+0x14C, then loads double;
a1 is an alignment hole, not a formal or an invented caller operand.
The declaration is a measured transport seed, not a game source publication.
